campaign: Repository tightening: shared tensor ingestion and direct protocol ownership
doctrine: Follow skill.md. Migrate every production caller and delete displaced loops, copies, wrappers, and tests in the same wave. Preserve numerical and protocol behavior. Add no compatibility path or speculative abstraction.

items.title: Remove the full-catalog snapshot copy from streamed prefix execution

steps.title: Borrow the immutable open source during prefix streaming and delete Source.Snapshot
steps.rationale: The sole production caller neither mutates nor outlives the source; copying every tensor map entry and shape adds memory without ownership value.

items.title: Delete protocol decode wrappers and duplicate Responses text-part parsing

steps.title: Call strict JSON authority directly and share one private Responses text-part decoder
steps.rationale: Remove pass-through wrappers and keep one typed text-part validation path without merging distinct protocol semantics.
